components.name: Range field
components.description: Range field — two Text fields (From · To) under one label, validated together with one shared message (price, dates, age). React: <RangeField label from to message dir />. Fields are exposed Text field L Filled instances, FILL width, gap scale/12. Error turns both fields to State=Error and shows a single message under the pair — never one error per field. Same anatomy as Fieldset (3.19).

3.20 Field groups.text:
Usage
When to use a field group instead of a Fieldset.
Fieldset (3.19) wraps ONE control. When the control is a group of things validated together — a set of chips, a from–to pair — use a field group.
Chip group: 2–8 short options that all fit on screen. Single or multiple choice is set per chip state; more than 8 → Select or a Bottom sheet list.
Range field: two values of the same kind. One label, one message; put the unit in the label (“Price, soʻm”), not in each field.
Validate the pair as one: if From > To, both fields turn Error and one message explains it.
Do not add a Fieldset around a field group — the group already has its label and message.
Anatomy: Header → controls → one message. Identical spacing to Fieldset (3.19). 1 Label · Label/M, text/secondary. 2 Hint · _Icon 16, opens a Tooltip — Show hint. 3 Optional · Caption/L, text/tertiary — Show optional. 4 Controls · Chip S wrap row (gap 8) or two Text field L (gap 12). 5 Message · Caption/L — Helper text/tertiary, Error text/danger + icon.
Sizes: One size. Width follows the form column (Mobile 358, Web up to 480); controls inside keep their own sizes. Chip size stays S; text fields stay L (56). Do not shrink controls to fit — wrap chips, and stack the range on very narrow screens.
States: The group has no states of its own; each chip or field keeps its own (Hover, Focus, Disabled). Error is set on the group.
Props: Message Variant None · Helper · Error (None) · Direction Variant LTR · RTL (LTR) · Label Text (Plan · Price, soʻm) · Message Text · Show hint Boolean Off · Show optional Boolean Off · Chips (Chip group) Nested instances 4 × Filter S · From · To (Range field) Nested (exposed) Text field Filled L.

Do / Don’t: Do — One message for the pair, under both fields. Don’t repeat the same error under each field — people read it twice and still don’t know which to fix. Do — Short options in one wrap row, one label. Don’t wrap a field group in a Fieldset — two labels, two messages.
